name: Turkey, Black Bean, and Sweet Potato Chili
description: Lean turkey chili with black beans and sweet potato, topped with Greek yogurt, cilantro, and lime.
recipeIngredient: 1 sweet potato (large, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes)
2 cans black beans (15 oz, drained and rinsed)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat olive oil in a dutch oven over medium-high. Add ground turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, 5-6 minutes.
Add a diced yellow onion and a pinch of salt and cook until soft, 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, dried oregano, and tomato paste. Cook until the paste darkens, 2 minutes.
Add sweet potato, black beans, diced tomatoes, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered until the sweet potato is tender and the chili has thickened, 30 minutes.
Stir in the juice of half a lime and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve topped with Greek yogurt, chopped cilantro, and wedges of lime.
Thickens overnight; loosen with a splash of water. Keeps 4 days, freezes up to 3 months.
